Axe, orc double.description: An orc double axe is a two-handed exotic double weapon with an axe head on each end.

Axe, throwing.description: A throwing axe is a light martial melee weapon designed to be thrown.

Battleaxe.description: A battleaxe is a one-handed martial melee weapon.

Bolas.description: A bolas is an exotic thrown ranged weapon used to trip opponents.

Chain, spiked.description: A spiked chain is a two-handed exotic melee weapon with reach that can also strike adjacent foes.

Club.description: A club is a one-handed simple melee weapon.

Crossbow, hand.description: A hand crossbow is a one-handed exotic ranged weapon.

Crossbow, heavy.description: A heavy crossbow is a two-handed simple ranged weapon.

Crossbow, light.description: A light crossbow is a two-handed simple ranged weapon.

Crossbow, repeating heavy.description: A repeating heavy crossbow is a two-handed exotic ranged weapon with a magazine.

Crossbow, repeating light.description: A repeating light crossbow is a two-handed exotic ranged weapon with a magazine.

Dagger.description: A dagger is a light simple melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Dagger, punching.description: A punching dagger is a light simple melee weapon designed for close-quarters stabbing.

Dart.description: A dart is a simple thrown ranged weapon.

Falchion.description: A falchion is a two-handed martial melee weapon with a broad curved blade.

Flail.description: A flail is a one-handed martial melee weapon.

Flail, dire.description: A dire flail is a two-handed exotic double weapon with a spiked ball on each end.

Flail, heavy.description: A heavy flail is a two-handed martial melee weapon.

Gauntlet.description: A gauntlet lets you deal lethal damage with an unarmed strike rather than nonlethal.

Gauntlet, spiked.description: A spiked gauntlet lets you deal lethal piercing damage with an unarmed strike.

Glaive.description: A glaive is a two-handed martial melee weapon with reach.

Greataxe.description: A greataxe is a two-handed martial melee weapon.

Greatclub.description: A greatclub is a two-handed martial melee weapon.

Greatsword.description: A greatsword is a two-handed martial melee weapon.

Guisarme.description: A guisarme is a two-handed martial melee weapon with reach.

Halberd.description: A halberd is a two-handed martial melee weapon combining an axe blade and a spike.

Hammer, gnome hooked.description: A gnome hooked hammer is a two-handed exotic double weapon with a hammer head and a hook.

Hammer, light.description: A light hammer is a light martial melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Handaxe.description: A handaxe is a light martial melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Javelin.description: A javelin is a one-handed simple thrown weapon.

Kama.description: A kama is a light exotic melee weapon, a monk weapon.

Kukri.description: A kukri is a light martial melee weapon with a curved blade.

Lance.description: A lance is a two-handed martial melee weapon designed for mounted combat.

Longbow.description: A longbow is a two-handed martial ranged weapon.

Longbow, composite.description: A composite longbow is a two-handed martial ranged weapon that can add Strength bonus to damage.

Longspear.description: A longspear is a two-handed simple melee weapon with reach.

Longsword.description: A longsword is a one-handed martial melee weapon.

Mace, heavy.description: A heavy mace is a one-handed simple melee weapon.

Mace, light.description: A light mace is a light simple melee weapon.

Morningstar.description: A morningstar is a one-handed simple melee weapon with a spiked metal ball.

Net.description: A net is an exotic thrown ranged weapon used to entangle opponents.

Nunchaku.description: A nunchaku is a light exotic melee weapon, a monk weapon.

Pick, heavy.description: A heavy pick is a one-handed martial melee weapon.

Pick, light.description: A light pick is a light martial melee weapon.

Quarterstaff.description: A quarterstaff is a two-handed simple melee weapon, a double weapon.

Ranseur.description: A ranseur is a two-handed martial melee weapon with reach.

Rapier.description: A rapier is a one-handed martial melee weapon favored for its precision.

Sai.description: A sai is a light exotic melee weapon, a monk weapon with a pointed blade and two prongs.

Sap.description: A sap is a light martial melee weapon that deals nonlethal damage.

Scimitar.description: A scimitar is a one-handed martial melee weapon with a curved blade.

Scythe.description: A scythe is a two-handed martial melee weapon.

Shortbow.description: A shortbow is a two-handed martial ranged weapon.

Shortbow, composite.description: A composite shortbow is a two-handed martial ranged weapon that can add Strength bonus to damage.

Shortspear.description: A shortspear is a one-handed simple melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Shuriken (5).description: A shuriken is an exotic thrown ranged weapon, a monk weapon.

Siangham.description: A siangham is a light exotic melee weapon, a monk weapon.

Sickle.description: A sickle is a light simple melee weapon resembling a farming tool.

Sling.description: A sling is a simple ranged weapon.

Spear.description: A spear is a two-handed simple melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Sword, bastard.description: A bastard sword is a one-handed exotic melee weapon (or two-handed martial).

Sword, short.description: A shortsword is a light martial melee weapon.

Sword, two-bladed.description: A two-bladed sword is a two-handed exotic double weapon with a blade on each end.

Trident.description: A trident is a one-handed martial melee weapon that can also be thrown.

Urgrosh, dwarven.description: A dwarven urgrosh is a two-handed exotic double weapon with an axe head and a spear point.

Waraxe, dwarven.description: A dwarven waraxe is a one-handed exotic melee weapon (or two-handed martial).

Warhammer.description: A warhammer is a one-handed martial melee weapon.

Whip.description: A whip is a one-handed exotic melee weapon with 15 ft. reach.

Banded mail.description: Banded mail is heavy armor made of overlapping strips of metal sewn to a leather backing.

Breastplate.description: A breastplate is medium armor covering the front and back torso.

Buckler.description: A buckler is a small metal shield worn strapped to the forearm.

Chain shirt.description: A chain shirt is light armor made of interlocking metal rings covering the torso.

Chainmail.description: Chain mail is medium armor made of interlocking metal rings.

Full plate.description: Full plate armor is heavy armor consisting of shaped metal plates covering the entire body.

Half-plate.description: Half-plate is heavy armor combining chainmail with metal plates covering vital areas.

Hide.description: Hide armor is medium armor made from the thick hides of animals.

Leather.description: Leather armor is light armor made of hardened leather.

Padded.description: Padded armor is light armor consisting of heavy, quilted cloth.

Scale mail.description: Scale mail is medium armor made of overlapping metal scales.

Shield, heavy steel.description: A heavy steel shield is a large shield made of steel.

Shield, heavy wooden.description: A heavy wooden shield is a large shield made of wood.

Shield, light steel.description: A light steel shield is a small shield made of steel.

Shield, light wooden.description: A light wooden shield is a small shield made of wood.

Shield, tower.description: A tower shield is a massive shield that provides cover but limits mobility.

Splint mail.description: Splint mail is heavy armor made of metal strips riveted to a leather backing.

Studded leather.description: Studded leather armor is light armor reinforced with metal rivets.
